quests.title: Geri's Gastro-Nostalgia

dialogue.t: Oh right, you must've seen my commission then. Have you prepared two dishes of Flaming Red Bolognese?

dialogue.sit: I certainly have, here they are.

dialogue.t: Mm-hmm! These Flaming Red Bolognese taste just like I remember.
Here, please take these. Thanks for bringing me the food!

quests.description: Geri needs two servings of Flaming Red Bolognese.
